# Diane Pepe — The Mortgage Pharmacist

> Diane Pepe is a mortgage loan officer with Fairway Independent Mortgage Corporation serving the Denver Metro area of Colorado and Lexington, Nebraska. She worked as a pharmacist for 25 years before moving into mortgage lending, which is why she is known as "The Mortgage Pharmacist." She helps first-time buyers, families, veterans, investors, relocating buyers and people downsizing choose the right home loan, with clear, patient, plain-language guidance.

## Key facts

- Name: Diane Pepe
- Title: Loan Officer
- Company: Fairway Independent Mortgage Corporation (NMLS #2289)
- Individual NMLS: 2061796
- Known as: The Mortgage Pharmacist
- Background: Pharmacist for 25 years; mortgage lending is her second career
- Based in: Franktown, Colorado
- Service areas: Denver Metro Area, Colorado (including Douglas County: Franktown, Parker, Castle Rock); Lexington, Nebraska and Dawson County
- Phone / text: (303) 249-0023
- Email: diane.pepe@home.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/diane_pepe/
- Consultations: free, no obligation

## Loan programs

- First-time home buyer loans (down payments from 3% conventional or 3.5% FHA; down payment assistance may apply)
- FHA loans
- VA loans
- Conventional loans
- Luxury and jumbo loans
- Refinancing (rate-and-term, cash-out, FHA streamline, VA IRRRL)
- Investment property loans
- New construction financing
- Relocation loans
- Downsizing loans
